device.name: POCO F7 / Redmi Turbo 4 Pro
device.boot_header: Android boot image v4, 4 KiB pages, kernel-only boot.img (ramdisk in init_boot.img)

kernel.why: Exact AOSP GKI commit from the stock kernel version string. Building the same source with the extracted stock config keeps vermagic and vendor module ABI compatible.

sukisu.version_note: Pinned to the revision that the reviewed SukiSU+SUSFS compatibility patch applies to cleanly.

patches.credit: SUSFS by simonpunk; SukiSU-Ultra by the SukiSU team; compatibility patch reviewed by Henry-Hilton (Onyx Wild Performance).
